purpose: Eugene dancing in a bent-knee shuffle with relaxed lowered hands, surrounded by a supportive disco crowd; original beady eyes and lanky build preserved.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / pose variation. Create one new version of the supplied EUGENE DISCO illustration (image 1), making TWO changes requested by the user: add a lively CROWD, and give Eugene a different dance pose with NO POINTING AT THE DISCO BALL. Image 2 is a five-photo dance-pose montage: use its loose bent-knee disco steps and swinging/bent arms as pose inspiration ONLY, especially the grounded knee-bend and stepping energy of the middle and fourth poses. Do not reproduce the actor, white suit, photo-strip format, photographic look or exact background.

PRESERVE EUGENE'S SUCCESSFUL ORIGINAL IDENTITY FROM IMAGE 1: small plain round BLACK BEADY EYES without whites or human eyebrows, simply faceted elongated PINK equine head and long thin neck, lavender chunky muzzle, ONE pearlescent pastel horn, upright pink ears, short blocky horizontal BANDED RAINBOW mane in mint/pale yellow/pink/lavender. Slim lanky NONMUSCULAR body, narrow sloping shoulders, thin long arms and legs, pink human hands. Original pale aqua TURTLENECK with sage-mint high collar and cuffs, small purple/white unicorn-head emblem, butter-yellow trousers and simple pink shoes. Keep his sweet slightly blank goofy little smile. No helmet, sunglasses, leather jacket, flowing glamour mane, human eyebrows, large anime eyes, broad chest or muscular anatomy. Do not redesign the character.

NEW DANCE POSE: Eugene is tearing it up in a GROUNDED PLAYFUL DISCO SHUFFLE: both knees bent, hips swiveling, torso slightly leaned and twisted, one foot planted out to the side and the other stepping inward on the ball of the foot, creating a lively rhythmic asymmetry. BOTH ARMS BENT AT THE ELBOWS with relaxed hands swinging near waist/lower-rib height, one reaching slightly forward and the other swept loosely sideways. All fingers relaxed or loosely curled, NO extended pointing index finger and NO raised arm aimed at the disco ball. The energy comes from the bent legs, twist, elbows and rhythm, not an exaggerated leap. Maintain clear natural two-arm/two-hand/two-leg anatomy. Make the pose recognizable and charming at small card size, endearingly awkward but confident. His face turns three-quarter toward the viewer. Show the full body with both pink shoes, full horn and hands inside frame and a little breathing room. Keep the chest emblem readable. He remains the large unmistakable hero.

ADD A CROWD: A semi-circle of about eight to ten adult nightclub dancers/onlookers in the mid-to-far background, at either side and behind Eugene. Some dance, a couple clap, others smile appreciatively. They are varied adult people in simple retro club clothing, rendered in the SAME angular faceted illustration style, NOT photoreal faces or realistic cutouts. Keep the crowd smaller in apparent scale, darker and lower-contrast in plum, navy, burgundy and teal, with restrained pink and amber edge lighting. Do not add any other unicorns or celebrity likenesses. Leave an open circle on the floor around Eugene and a clean darker patch behind his head/neck, so no crowd face, hand or head tangles with his silhouette. Do not fill the foreground with crowd bodies or block his legs. The crowd should make it feel like an actual lively disco while preserving his star moment.

KEEP THE DISCO: One large mirrored disco ball high toward the upper-right, fully recognizable and clearly separate from his horn and hands; it is part of the setting rather than something he points at. Deep violet nightclub, warm golden spotlights, magenta and cyan beams, small square mirror-ball reflections, glossy neon checkerboard dance floor receding into the distance. Make a visible strip of large luminous floor tiles in the lower foreground for depth, Eugene in the middle plane and crowd/light beams in the far plane. Keep the rich card-art color and polished crisp low-poly sculpted facets of image 1. Warm rim light and cool disco reflections on the sweater, subtle reflections under feet. No added props or drinks in Eugene's hands.

Deliver ONE unified full-bleed portrait illustration approximately 1024 x 1536, no split panels or contact sheet, no lettering, numbers, border, logos or watermark. Must retain original sweet BEADY-EYED LANKY Eugene, change the pointing pose to a bent-knee shuffle with lowered bent arms, and add the crowd without sacrificing a clean hero silhouette.
